acceptance: A failed parallel transformation marks the pipeline failed and names the failed files, with a test injecting a failure
A phase with a missing processor or no work is reported incomplete or failed, with a test
Sequential and parallel paths report the same outcome for the same failure
context: 2026-10-04 concurrency adversarial review. Exception handler verified directly.
description:
benchbox/core/tpcdi/benchmark.py:1669-1675 (develop 8ed0c64e1) catches each parallel transformation future's exception, prints it and continues. run_etl_pipeline then sets success=True (:1587) with partial staged data. The sequential path (:1621-1634) raises instead. With enable_parallel=True, one bad source file silently drops a table's data and the run is still successful. This is the only TPC-DI concurrent path left after #2222. The unmerged branch origin/fix/tpcdi-parallel-phase-truthful-outcome (closed PR #2217) targeted the deleted parallel_batch_processor.py and does not cover it.

Also: _run_enhanced_data_processing defaults to success: True (:2496). If a requested processor is None or no files are generated, the phase "succeeds" with zero records, contrary to the concurrency outcome ADR section 1 (incomplete/failed).
